headline: Instagram chases YouTube with a push for longer, widescreen videos
summary: Instagram is launching "Features" for longer, horizontal videos. This new format directly challenges YouTube's dominance in longform content. Instagram leadership previously resisted longform video but is now embracing it.

headline: Microsoft offers buyouts to 60,000 employees
summary: Microsoft is offering voluntary buyouts to 60,000 employees globally. The program aims to trim staff without mandatory layoffs. Employees will receive financial support and career resources.

headline: T-Mobile’s new plans include swappable subscription perks
summary: T-Mobile is introducing new "T-Mix" plans with bundled wireless service. Plans include swappable perks like Netflix, Apple TV, and Xbox Game Pass Ultimate. The Standard plan starts at $55/month for one line and one "Pick."

headline: Microsoft’s new Surface Laptop Ultra update fixes reboot and display bugs
summary: Microsoft has released a firmware update for the Surface Laptop Ultra. The update resolves issues like screen flickering and unexpected restarts. It also improves lengthy reboot times and overall performance.

headline: Heroes Never Die, a Survivor-Plus-Tactics Strategy Game, Announced for PC
summary: "Heroes Never Die," a new PC strategy game, has been announced. It blends elements of Vampire Survivors with Heroes of Might and Magic. The game features tactical decisions, army building, and fantasy heroes, set for a 2027 release.

headline: Horror Games Are Getting Big Discounts in the Lead-Up to Halloween
summary: Major discounts are available on popular horror games. Sales include titles like Resident Evil and Silent Hill. Promotions are running at Amazon and Best Buy ahead of Halloween.

headline: The Simpsons Halloween Episodes: Every 'Treehouse of Horror' Special, Ranked
summary: A ranking of every "Treehouse of Horror" special from The Simpsons has been published. The list covers episodes from Season 2 to Season 38. It evaluates the iconic Halloween specials using fan-favorite references.

headline: The Simpsons: 'Treehouse of Horror XXXVII' Review
summary: A review for "Treehouse of Horror XXXVII" of The Simpsons has been released. The episode is deemed passable but not as strong as other recent Halloween specials. It's compared against Season 38's other Halloween installment.

headline: Independent review announced into murder of student Henry Nowak
summary: An independent review has been launched into the murder of student Henry Nowak. The Home Secretary emphasized getting to the truth of the events. The review will examine circumstances before, during, and after the incident.

headline: Chris Brown given suspended eight-month prison sentence over nightclub attack
summary: Chris Brown received a suspended eight-month prison sentence. This follows his guilty plea to affray for a nightclub attack. The R&B star assaulted a music producer with a glass bottle.

headline: Storm Boelo leaves 90,000 without power as Met Office issues new wind warning
summary: Storm Boelo has caused significant power outages, affecting 90,000 properties. Strong winds battered Scotland and northern England. The Met Office has issued new wind warnings for affected regions.

headline: Healey to shield low-income pensioners from income tax in the Budget
summary: Healey plans to protect low-income pensioners from income tax in the upcoming Budget. Changes are needed as the state pension rise could make it liable for tax. The measure aims to prevent the full, flat-rate state pension from being taxed.
